hero_builds_json_shapes.name: hero_builds_json_shapes
hero_builds_json_shapes.value: jsonb_typeof("hero_builds"."skills") = 'array' AND jsonb_typeof("hero_builds"."gear") = 'array' AND jsonb_typeof("hero_builds"."auras") = 'array' AND jsonb_typeof("hero_builds"."summary") = 'object'

realms_sha256.name: realms_sha256
realms_sha256.value: ("realms"."data" IS NULL AND "realms"."sha256" IS NULL) OR ("realms"."data" IS NOT NULL AND "realms"."sha256" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$')

chat_messages_hidden.name: chat_messages_hidden
chat_messages_hidden.value: ("chat_messages"."hidden_at" IS NULL) = ("chat_messages"."hidden_by" IS NULL) AND ("chat_messages"."hidden_by" IS NULL OR "chat_messages"."hidden_by" IN ('reports', 'moderator'))

chat_reports_resolution.name: chat_reports_resolution
chat_reports_resolution.value: ("chat_reports"."resolution" IS NULL) = ("chat_reports"."resolved_at" IS NULL) AND ("chat_reports"."resolution" IS NULL OR "chat_reports"."resolution" IN ('dismiss', 'hide', 'mute'))
